justification: Inspected javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/body/AnnotationMemberDeclaration.java and javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/body/BodyDeclaration.java. The target class is only 301 LOC, has 4 fields (modifiers, type, name, defaultValue), and its public API is almost entirely AST boilerplate: constructors plus generated getters/setters, visitor accept methods, clone/replace/remove, type-casting helpers, and resolve(). It models one coherent AST concept (an annotation member declaration) rather than multiple separable responsibilities; shared annotation handling is inherited from BodyDeclaration, so there is no concrete evidence of insufficient modularization.
